text:
maya: Late crag session tonight? Forecast looks good, wall should be quiet after 7pm. 7pm at the east parking lot? Who's in? :mountain:
owen: I'm in. Can lead a few 5.10s. Need a belayer for the harder lines?
jin: I can belay and bring an extra pair of shoes for someone in size 9.
lisa: Might be late, finishing a class. If I can't make ropes I'll join for bouldering only. :chalk:️
alex: Bringing a friend who's totally new to rope climbing — can we keep at least a couple routes beginner-friendly?
maya: Absolutely. I'll set up 2 top-ropes on 5.7-5.9 and one moderate 5.10. Alex, bring your friend and I'll demo basic belay commands. Meeting point: East lot by the big oak sign.
sam: Carpool from office? I can take 2 people. Leaving lobby at 6:15. Reply if you want a spot.
maya: @sam awesome — DM me who you can grab. Quick logistics poll: who's bringing Rope/Helmet/Chalk? Reply with R/H/C or 'no'
owen: R,C
jin: C (and extra screwgate if anyone needs)
lisa: no (bouldering only)
alex: R,H
sam: C
climbbot: Crag update: conditions dry, temp ~62F, parking free. No route closures reported.
maya: Packing list (put this in your bag):
```
- 1x 60m rope (R)
- 2 harnesses
- 2 quickdraws / 4 lockers + extra carabiners
- Chalk bag(s) (C)
- Climbing shoes + belay device
- Helmet (H) if you have one
- Water + snack
- Small first-aid / tape
```
jin: FYI ticks were spotted near the oak last weekend — bring DEET and check shoes/clothes after.
owen: Also bring a small headlamp if you have one, just in case we run late.
maya: Sweet. I'll bring a spare helmet and an extra locking carabiner. See y'all at 6:15 for carpool or 7 at the lot. :thumbsup:
maya: :party:
